latin: Per hanc dictionem <WN>; quae scribitur per Aleph, Iod, et / Scin, et significat Virum, quae deo attribuiturcum dicitur Vir belli, de trinitatis mysterio per uiam Cabalae perfectissime admonemur.

mentions.context: litteram VJ, id est sein, quae mediat in nomine Iesu, significatur nobis, cabalistice quod tumperfecte quievit, tanquam in suaperfectione, mundus cum Iod coniunctus est cum Vau, quodfactum est in Christo, quifuit verus deifilius et homo. 126 Dazu auch Pico, Conclusio cabalistica..., 11>33. (S. 534). 127 Pico, Conclusio cabalistica..., 11>43. (S. 538): Per mysterium duarum litterarum vau et iod scitur quomodo ipse messias ut deus fuit prineipium suiipsius ut homo.

It was from Recanati, not from the biblical commentary of Moses ben Nahman of Gerona or the writings of Eleazar of Worms, that Pico learned that all peculiarities of the Masorah represented mysteries of the ten seflrot (Conclusio xxxiii). It was likewise in Recanati, and not by his own wits, that Pico found the shrewd combination of texts that brought out some particular points, such as the proper attitude at prayer (Conclusio xxxiv).
